atoms.text:
Tammy the turtle lives on a lily pad. Tammy likes to eat insects. “Grasshoppers are my favourite!” said Tammy.

Tammy sat on a log. Tammy saw a grasshopper. “Ah ha! I found dinner!”

Then Tammy saw a bird. He looked hungry. Tammy asked, “Mr Bird would you like to share my grasshopper?”

Mr Bird said, “Yes! I love to eat grasshoppers too.”

Tammy and Mr Bird are friends now. They often share grasshoppers.

atoms.text:
Taylor likes to climb trees. Taylor likes to pretend he is a monkey. He climbs as high as he can go.

He yells, “I am a monkey!”

Taylor’s mum walks to the tree. She yells up, “It is snack time, does monkey want a snack?”

Taylor climbs down the tree. Taylor eats his banana.
